name: SignHero
tagline: A rhythm game that teaches ASL fingerspelling: sign the letters on the beat and the webcam scores you.

awards: Best Overall Sponsored By Vobile (1st, 2nd, & 3rd Place)

problem: Millions of people are deaf or hard of hearing, yet few hearing people learn sign language, the team says.
solution: MediaPipe hand tracking recognises fingerspelled letters in real time across a music-highway mode, training and timed tests and an arcade reflex game.
demo_moment: Team-described: sign letters along a scrolling song chart.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Overall Sponsored By Vobile (1st, 2nd, & 3rd Place)” and “Best Game Design Project” among 112 submissions.
Borrows a famous rhythm-game format to make practice fun.
Placed in Best Overall and won Best Game Design.

lessons: A game loop people already love makes repetitive practice stick.
